summary: Mobile audit at 390x844 viewport across client + admin pages of avopt.store. Performed live measurements (docScrollWidth vs viewportWidth, per-element bounding rects, tap-target size, overflowing tables). Catalog 2-column grid fix is confirmed working (gridTemplateColumns='173px 173px'). Identified ONE source of true horizontal page scroll on the admin dashboard, several content overflows that are visually clipped by ancestor overflow:hidden (cosmetic), tap targets under 36px, and the AdminPage header layout that breaks on mobile. Tables in admin orders/products/warehouse are already wrapped in overflow-x-auto and behave correctly.

ui_bugs.component: AdminPage header row (/admin and all admin tabs)
ui_bugs.issue: Whole page scrolls horizontally at 390px. The header row uses `flex items-center justify-between mb-6` containing the H1 'Панель администратора' AND a `whitespace-nowrap` Button 'Настроить вкладки' (~163px wide, Settings icon + Russian label). The button cannot shrink and overflows past viewport (measured right=406 in winW=390). docScrollWidth=406 > 390 -> entire admin page scrolls sideways. Present on dashboard, warehouse, and every admin tab because header is shared.

TabsList scrollWidth=427 vs container width=356. Parent has overflow-x-auto so tabs DO swipe horizontally (works), BUT the strip computed style is overflowX:visible on the TabsList itself, and at 390px it shows ~5.5 icons with the right edge cut. Tabs have no visible scroll affordance (no arrow/shadow) so users may not know more tabs exist. 9 children total. Suggest adding fade/gradient on right edge or chevron indicator.

The pill/rounded-full promo banner has intrinsic width 458px in a 390px viewport (right=424). Not clipped by parent overflow-hidden so the close-button (data-testid='promo-banner-close') sits at right=412, partially under the viewport edge. Appears on Home, Cart, Orders, Product, Contact. Visually the right-side rounded curve is cut. Close X tap-target is also small (28x28).

Mobile hamburger button is 40x32 (height < 36) — borderline non-tappable. Hamburger menu when opened (unauthenticated) shows ONLY the 'Войти' button — no categories/contact/cart link in the drawer. Mobile users have no navigation to Catalog/Contact/News from a logged-out state through the menu.

ui_bugs.component: PopularProducts add-to-cart buttons in horizontal rail
ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='add-popular-{id}' buttons are 32x32 — below 36px tap target minimum. There are ~10 of these on the home/catalog popular-products rail.
Anchor is only 116x28 in height — under 36px minimum.
Tap area is only 104x16. Underline only, very small target.

ui_bugs.component: PopularProducts cards in horizontal rail (home + catalog)
ui_bugs.issue: Card content is too narrow (~140px each) and price/'Нет в наличии' badge wraps awkwardly. Text 'PACCAR'/'SAF'/'BPW' partner cards in 'Партнёры' row also extend off-screen but inside overflow-x-auto so it's intentional. Brand label inside cards is truncated heavily (visible '1 6' instead of price '1 600 ₽').

action_items: PRIORITY 1 (true horizontal page scroll on admin): In AdminPage.js around line 1329 change `<div className='flex items-center justify-between mb-6'>` to `<div className='flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 mb-6'>` and add `flex-shrink-0` + maybe icon-only label on mobile to the 'Настроить вкладки' Button.

PRIORITY 2: Constrain promo banner to viewport. In HeaderPromoBanner, wrap with `max-w-full overflow-hidden` on parent OR change the pill to have `w-fit max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] mx-auto` and replace rounded-full with rounded-2xl on <sm.
PRIORITY 2: Add scroll affordance to admin TabsList — gradient/fade on right edge of `div.overflow-x-auto` or a small chevron-right indicator hidden on `sm:hidden`.
PRIORITY 3: Increase tap-target heights to ≥36px for: logo-link, hamburger button, footer-email, promo-banner-close, add-popular-* buttons (use min-h-9 / p-2).
PRIORITY 3: Mobile hamburger menu should expose Catalog, Contact, News, Login/Register navigation when logged out (currently only 'Войти').
PRIORITY 3: PopularProducts cards on mobile rail are too narrow (~140px) — price truncates. Either widen cards (snap-width 70%) or stack price under title without truncating.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.js is 5041 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Split into per-tab subcomponents (DashboardTab, WarehouseTab, etc.).
Promo banner uses rounded-full + fixed inner widths that don't shrink; needs responsive width.
Hamburger menu drawer content missing nav links for anonymous users — likely a routing/conditional rendering miss in Header.js.
Several whitespace-nowrap buttons in admin headers risk overflow on narrow screens; consider icon-only at <sm.

success_rate.frontend: Audit complete: 1 critical layout bug, 4 medium, 4 low

rca of the issue: Root cause of horizontal scroll on /admin: AdminPage.js line 1329 uses a single horizontal flex row with a long Russian H1 and a `whitespace-nowrap` 163px Button. At width 390px after px-4 padding, the available content width is ~358px. The H1 wraps to 2 lines and the Button is forced to not wrap, so it pushes the row to ~390+16px wide -> creates 16px horizontal scroll. Fix: stack to column on <sm OR icon-only button on <sm. Reproduction: open https://order-merge-fulfill.preview.emergentagent.com/admin at viewport 390x844 -> page can scroll left/right by ~16px and the trailing edge of the 'Настроить вкладки' button is clipped.
